source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Clearly note any and all obstructed pathways, including in parking areas, entrances, and throughout the building. Record the precise location, type, and dimensions of each obstruction, and provide photographs with clear tagging.
3. Record any non-compliant doorways—measure doorway widths, and note the condition of automatic door openers, doorknobs, and handles.
4. Evaluate and document ramps and lifts for compliance with requirements—measure gradient, width, surfacing, handrails, and landings.
5. Assess signage for clarity and visibility—document any missing, inadequately lit, or poorly positioned signage, including Braille and tactile signage.
6. Measure and document the height and depth of any carpeting, ensuring it aligns with safety standards.
7. Test and document accessible restroom facilities—measure the amount of space required for maneuvering, ensure the presence of grab bars, accessible sinks, mirror height, and/
8. Verify emergency hardware
